basic_info.description: Presidio Laurel - rare luxury new construction in Presidio & Laurel Heights.  Beautifully appointed new condominium homes with modern designer finishes, including Taj Mahal stone counters, Riva white oak flooring, EcoSmart fireplaces, Miele appliances, Leicht cabinetry, Waterworks fixtures, Carrara & French Limestone.  3643 California is a spacious 2 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom home featuring a large exclusive south-facing patio with fire pit. Close to boutiques, restaurants, cafes & Laurel Village.
